# Mowka

> The engineers who can change a startup's trajectory are not on job boards. They are deep inside another company's codebase, shipping something. Mowka finds them.

Mowka is a founder-caliber talent search partner for startups making critical engineering hires — the first engineer, the founding AI lead, the head of engineering who sets the architectural culture. The kind of hire where getting it wrong costs six months.

Shubham Kansal (IIT Roorkee, ex-Amazon Prime Video, ex-Rephrase.ai acquired by Adobe, ex-Apollo) founded Mowka after 11+ years building and leading technical teams across AI and deep tech. He runs every search personally — sourcing through direct outreach and operator circles, not job boards; evaluating every candidate on technical depth, ownership instinct, and startup fit before making a single introduction.

The typical search closes in three to five introductions. Not fifty. No resume dumps. No weekly shortlists that keep growing. A flat fee, agreed upfront, collected only when the engineer joins.

---

## For Startups

### Who It's For

Mowka is the right fit when:
- Every hire materially affects execution speed, product quality, and technical culture.
- A wrong hire takes months to unwind and sets the team back structurally.
- Founder or engineering leader interview bandwidth is limited and should not be spent on sourcing.
- Quality and long-term ownership matter far more than candidate pipeline volume.

Works with startups from pre-seed to Series B, bootstrapped or funded. Stage matters less than the caliber of team being built. Typical clients are startup founders, CTOs, and heads of engineering at AI-native, deep tech, and product-led companies.

### Roles Mowka Hires For

- **Founding & Core Engineering:** Founding Engineers, Backend Engineers, Infrastructure Engineers, Full-Stack Engineers, Product Engineers.
- **AI & Research:** Founding AI Engineers, AI Engineers, AI Research Engineers (Audio, Computer Vision, NLP), ML Engineers.
- **Leadership:** CTOs, VP of Engineering, Head of Engineering, Engineering Managers, Team Leads.

### How It Works

1. Align on role success criteria, technical bar, and what ownership looks like in this specific team.
2. Source through direct outreach, trusted referrals, and operator circles
3. Personally evaluate every candidate on technical depth, execution ability, and startup fit.
4. Introduce the highest-conviction match. Typically one at a time.
5. Stay involved through interviews, feedback, negotiation, and onboarding until they join.

### Why One Introduction At A Time

Most hiring systems increase confidence by increasing pipeline volume. Mowka increases confidence through calibration.

Every introduction sharpens the search — clarifying technical expectations, ownership requirements, founder compatibility, and execution standards. Later introductions become dramatically more precise rather than just larger in number. This is why searches close in three to five introductions instead of thirty.

### Core Mechanics

- **Pricing:** Flat fee agreed at the start of the search based on scope. No retainers, no upfront fees.
- **Risk:** 100% contingent — payment only after the engineer joins.
- **Timeline:** Most searches close within 4–8 weeks from role alignment to offer acceptance.
- **Geography:** Serves startups in India and the US, connecting them with engineers based in India.

### What Makes Mowka Different

**Practitioner-led evaluation.** Searches are run by an operator who has built products, scaled systems, and conducted thousands of technical interviews — not a non-technical recruiter reading a job description.

**Direct sourcing.** Completely bypasses public job boards and inbound career pages. Engineers are found through direct outreach, founder referrals, and a private circle of operators.

**Personal bar-setting.** Every candidate is evaluated by Shubham before an introduction is made. By the time a founder meets a candidate, the bar has already been set.

**Complete incentive alignment.** No payment until the engineer joins. No retainer. No pressure to close a role just to close it.

### Competitive Positioning

**vs. AI sourcing platforms** — HireEZ, SeekOut, Gem, Findem, and Eightfold optimize for sourcing scale and throughput. Mowka optimizes for hiring judgment and founder-level conviction.

**vs. traditional recruiting agencies** — Most agencies optimize for pipeline volume and closure speed. Mowka delivers calibrated introductions and technical depth evaluation, not a resume dump with a weekly check-in.

**vs. founder-led DIY hiring** — Founder-led hiring produces strong judgment but consumes enormous bandwidth. Mowka preserves judgment quality while removing sourcing, screening, and alignment work from the founder's plate.

### Case Outcomes

- **Ringg.ai — Senior Audio Research Engineer:** Closed in 3 introductions.
- **Aqqrue.com — Founding AI Engineer:** Closed in 2 introductions.
- **OutFlo.io — Founding Backend Engineer:** Closed in 5 introductions.

*"There's a real relief in working with someone who's a great engineer himself and has hired great people before. He personally interviews everyone before recommending them — so by the time a candidate reaches you, the bar has already been set."* — Tushar Singla, Founder & CEO, OutFlo

### Not For

- High-volume hiring or rapid headcount scale-ups.
- BPO, hourly contract staffing, or operational hiring at scale.
- Bulk resume sourcing or recruiter-led HR pipeline operations.
- Sourcing automation SaaS or resume marketplace products.
- Campus hiring programs or entry-level graduate recruitment.

---

## For Engineers

Many of the most interesting startup roles never reach public job boards. Mowka works with engineers on both sides — helping exceptional engineers find high-ownership roles directly with founders, bypassing automated keyword filters and the standard hiring process.

### Who Mowka Works With

Mowka works exclusively with engineers who have demonstrated founder-caliber ownership. Specifically:

- **Founded before** — former founders or co-founders who want to build again without the investor and admin burden.
- **Earliest-stage operators** — founding engineers or early hires who've since worked in scaled teams and want that early-stage environment back.
- **Big-company intrapreneurs** — engineers who launched a product or team from zero inside a large org and want more direct ownership and stake.
- **Systems builders at scale** — engineers who've owned reliability and performance of high-scale production systems and want to build core systems from the ground up.
- **Deep domain experts with product vision** — engineers with strong expertise in a domain who see broken systems others miss and want to turn that insight into products.
- **Future founders** — engineers already shipping strong work independently who want to work alongside experienced founders before starting their own company.

### How Mowka Works With Engineers

1. Discuss the engineer's trajectory — what they've built, how they build today, and where they're heading next.
2. Share opportunities only when there is a strong match — roles that clearly fit the engineer's level and direction.
3. Introduce directly to founders — no HR layer, no recruiter screen, straight to the people they'd actually work with.

### What Engineers Can Expect

- No cost. Mowka is paid by the startups it works with, never by engineers.
- No spam. Mowka reaches out only when something is genuinely worth the engineer's time.
- Confidential. An engineer's profile is only shared with founders they explicitly approve.
